notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.1
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30213876/9e0d06ea80eb4e6e3e6e264e7f387772c3fd61ec.png

Hello, everyone! We have a bunch of updates in this version!

New Hud Added!
We added new hud to the game.

New Boss Added!
We added a new boss to the training map. This boss will spawn every 1 hour. Also when the boss gets killed players which are attacking to the boss, will get awards. Also, top 3 damage dealer will get a bonus.
Top player will get 500 coins
Second player will get 400 coins.
Third player will get 300 coins.
Others will gain 200 coins.
Boss will attack only damage dealers.

Minions have been changed.
We changed the visuals of minions.

Balance time!
Base health regen increased to 1000 from 400
Base damage increased to 800 from 200
Lotharius: Lifesteal from RMB ability was reduced.
Cadmael: LMB ability can't spam anymore.

notes.title: Rise of One is F2P Now!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30213876/5753acd6fee40774720514fdeaead6e276381e3e.png

Rise of One is F2P Now!

 We created the party system. You can now play the 4v4 mode with your friends.
 We re-designed the maps and solve the optimization problems.
 We added new costume and weapon skins.
 We renewed the in-game sounds.
 We improved the interface.
 You can now buy runes in-game and improve your characters stats like armor,crit chance, lifesteal etc. till the match ends.
 We developed a new talent system. You can now choose attiributes and create your own build in the game.


We are planning to include the Paragon characters and reconstruct them according to our game dynamics, in this process, we are looking forward for your opinions and suggestions.

We are now working on a training map. In this map ;
-There will be test dummies to try your skills.
-There will be a small area in the map where you can fight against other players.

Only North-America and Europe servers are online for now. We are planning to expand the servers on demand.
